topic: A resume moves a pin only to a fresh top-level harness in the same space
detail: SP-017 moves a pin on SessionStart source=resume only when the new harness process could take a new pin of its own (not inside another session, holding no pin, not an orphan, under 5 minutes old, kernel-verified cwd) and its directory places into the pin's space. orchd cannot tell an in-process /resume from an agent calling PinSession itself to take a dead session of its space and write that session's command log (SP-017 security review, round 1 medium), so an in-process /resume of another process's session is refused and that session's tool events go to the process's own pin. A 'claude --resume' started in a directory of another space is also refused and that session runs unpinned. Confirm, or decide another rule.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: confirmed as built; see D-41.
